method: Walking times are computed, not quoted. No Strip resort publishes a walking time from its hotel to a poker room. One OpenStreetMap / OSRM pedestrian-routing table request over the official street addresses returns every hotel-to-hotel and hotel-to-venue pair used here. Each pair also carries a Google Maps and an Apple Maps walking-directions link so the figure can be confirmed in a map application before booking.
